statement: A trust metric MUST NOT report golden_fraction_pct without the by_provenance breakdown.
why_this_is_the_dangerous_case: Four of five components are present and every number is correct. What is missing is the only one that shows the fraction's composition — so a reader sees 71% trusted and cannot tell whether it rests on twelve reviewed records or on a single one. That is precisely the blended number PROV-012 forbids.
note: The omission is the violation; do not add by_provenance to this fixture.
